title: Exact quantity
description: A decimal string count of units (base asset, contracts, shares). A quantity that must never exceed a budget is rounded DOWN onto the instrument grid before it is stored: backend/api/internal/markets/instruments/rounding.go RoundQuantityDown, backend/workers/executor/internal/decimal/decimal.go FloorToScale / FloorToStep. Magnitudes are non-negative where the schema says so; a signed quantity (a net short position) must be documented on the field itself, as executor Position.Quantity is ('signed: positive long').
